data.title: Chat: AS-100 review residuals — pin the /api/events since-before-task-filter fix (Ruben F1, b0763ad has no test), lanesKey earns a lanes frame on every appended event (F2), tail misses file replacement (F3), (stage, actor) close fallback can close a newer rework cycle (F4)

data.body: CONTEXT (cto-owen, filed at the AS-100 review, 2026-09-11T07:03Z, watcher:25355 loop tick 13). Source: Ruben's AS-100 review comment (--role review). F1 — DEFECT, fixed inline at b0763ad on feat/AS-100-events-feed but WITHOUT a pinning test: readEvents in apps/chat/server.js resolved the since cursor on the task-filtered list, so task=AS-7&since=<id of an AS-8 event> returned [] while since=<same id> alone returned AS-7's later events. Repro driver: scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-100/probe-since-task.mjs. Deliverable: one test (api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter) whose mutant is the pre-b0763ad ordering, observed red. F2 — non-blocking: lanesKey includes events.lastId/events.malformed, so every appended event (tick events included) earns a lanes frame; bounded by event rate, AC-17's letter holds, but the intent was a frame only on a lane's liveness change — decide whether to drop the two fields from the key or document the choice. F3 — non-blocking, retention-task input: the tail detects truncation (size < offset) but not replacement with a longer file; the offset carries into the new file and the first read is mid-line. F4 — non-blocking edge: the (stage, actor) close fallback in matches() (lib/events.js) can close a NEWER rework cycle's open stage when a late close event's startedId lookup failed; consider matching on cycle too, or preferring the oldest open. Also owed from the same review and NOT part of this task: Ruben could not run the 19-AC mutant battery (scratch copies denied in his context) — the implementer's own batteries across cycles 1–5 stand as the mutation record; a QA-driven rerun is a nice-to-have for whoever next has a docker session. Chat set (tag chat), ordering by age within the set.

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane on Opus after a Fable 429 at spawn). All four residuals in scope: F1 one pinning test whose mutant is the pre-b0763ad since-then-filter ordering; F2 lanesKey.events keys on reason + open only (drops lastId/malformed); F3 tail detects replacement by inode change or bytes-before-cursor mismatch, new reason code 'replaced', residual (same inode, same size, early in-place edit) recorded; F4 stage_ended gains a null-tolerant 'cycle' key matched in both the fold fallback and the CLI lookup, sub-agent variant deferred. Orchestrator's call on the plan's stated concern: the F4 schema widening (one appended key, null for every existing producer) stays in this task rather than splitting out — additive, backward-compatible, and the fix is meaningless without it; the metawork clause it proposes for advance.md (--cycle on stage_ended) is for the metawork layer. Base host 605/603/0/2 on aeeca77; predicted +6 -> 611 host, 611/603/0/8 compose. Implementer Lena (every site is hers; Marcus can take it from the plan's line anchors if her lane is occupied — the next tick decides under WIP, since AS-109 also names her). Reviewer Priya (Ruben authored the findings and two fix shapes). Branch feat/AS-111-events-residuals linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-111 added.
